chapter_title: The Historic Liberation War of Bangladesh (1971)

questions.question: Where did Bangabandhu deliver his historic speech on 7 March 1971?
questions.explanation: Bangabandhu gave his immortal 7 March speech calling 'The struggle this time is for our freedom...' at the Race Course Maidan.

questions.question: The brutal military crackdown launched by the Pakistan Army on 25 March 1971 was codenamed:
questions.explanation: Operation Searchlight was the premeditated genocidal military operation launched on unarmed civilians on the dark night of 25 March 1971.

questions.question: Where did the Mujibnagar Government take the formal oath of office on 17 April 1971?
questions.explanation: The first government of Bangladesh was sworn in at the mango grove of Baidyanathtala, Meherpur, which was renamed Mujibnagar.

questions.question: Who served as the Prime Minister of the Mujibnagar Government in 1971?
questions.explanation: Tajuddin Ahmad led the provisional government with outstanding statesmanship as the first Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

questions.question: How many military sectors was Bangladesh divided into during the Liberation War?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh territory was divided into 11 military sectors under the supreme command of General M.A.G. Osmani.
